shortDefinition: Legal questions around ownership of AI-generated content and training data use.
fullDefinition: AI copyright encompasses several unresolved legal questions: whether AI-generated content is copyrightable, whether training AI on copyrighted material is infringement, and who owns AI-generated output. Major lawsuits are being filed globally. Practical guidance: treat AI-generated content with the same copyright awareness as any other tools; avoid generating content very close to specific copyrighted works; check terms of service for your AI tool.
